text: Relevant authorities have stated that they will continue to increase investment to further improve the urban public transportation network system.
src: 有关部门表示将继续加大投入，进一步完善城市公共交通网络体系。

text: According to a report from the press conference, the cooperative project will cover more than 20 major cities across the country.
src: 记者从发布会上了解到，本次合作项目将覆盖全国二十多个主要城市。

text: Experts point out that the digital economy is becoming an important engine and supporting force for promoting coordinated regional development.
src: 专家指出，数字经济正在成为推动区域协调发展的重要引擎和支撑力量。

text: The implementation of this policy will benefit tens of millions of families and significantly reduce their financial burden on medical expenses.
src: 该政策的实施将惠及数千万家庭，显著减轻群众在医疗方面的支出负担。

text: As temperatures gradually rise, spring plowing and preparation work is underway in various regions, with an overall sufficient supply of agricultural materials.
src: 随着气温逐渐回升，各地春耕备耕工作陆续展开，农资供应总体充足。

text: According to the organizers, this year's expo features eight exhibition halls and a record number of participating companies.
src: 主办方介绍，本届博览会共设八大展馆，参展企业数量创历史新高。

text: Data shows that exports of new energy vehicles have grown significantly over the past year, accounting for nearly 30% of total vehicle exports.
src: 数据显示，过去一年新能源汽车出口大幅增长，占汽车出口总量近三成。

text: The newly built sports center, with a capacity for 60,000 spectators, will become the city's new landmark.
src: 新建成的体育中心可容纳六万名观众，将成为城市新的地标性建筑。

text: The research team completed the project over a five-year period, and the results have been published in an authoritative international journal.
src: 研究团队历时五年完成了这项课题，成果已在国际权威期刊上发表。

text: The local government has taken multiple measures to boost tourism spending, with a significant year-on-year increase in the number of tourists received during the holiday.
src: 当地政府多措并举促进旅游消费，假期接待游客量同比明显增长。

text: This exercise primarily tested the coordinated operational capabilities of the emergency command system under complex conditions.
src: 这次演习重点检验了应急指挥系统在复杂条件下的协同作战能力。

text: After three months of intensive construction, the renovation project of this old factory zone has successfully passed the final acceptance inspection.
src: 经过三个月的紧张施工，这片老旧厂区改造工程顺利通过竣工验收。

text: The report suggests that the green, low-carbon transition will create significant market space and opportunities for related industries.
src: 报告认为，绿色低碳转型将为相关产业带来巨大的市场空间和机遇。

text: Traffic authorities remind the public that highway traffic volume is high during holidays. Please plan your route reasonably before traveling.
src: 交管部门提醒，节假日期间高速车流量大，出行前请合理规划路线。

text: The laboratory has brought together a group of outstanding young scholars, who have achieved multiple original results in the field of artificial intelligence.
src: 该实验室聚集了一批优秀青年学者，在人工智能领域取得多项原创成果。

text: The meteorological observatory forecasts strong winds and a temperature drop in the northern region over the next three days, with local sandstorms.
src: 气象台预计未来三天北方地区将出现大风降温天气，局地伴有沙尘。

text: Data from the business sector shows that the consumer market continues to recover, with the integration of online and offline channels becoming more pronounced.
src: 商务部门数据显示，消费市场持续回暖，线上线下融合趋势更加明显。

text: This tunnel crossing the mountains is over twelve kilometers long, and several technical challenges were overcome during its construction.
src: 这条穿越山脉的隧道全长超过十二公里，建设过程中攻克了多项技术难题。

text: Over 200 infrared cameras have been installed in the reserve to monitor the activity patterns of wildlife.
src: 保护区内已安装两百多个红外相机，用于监测野生动物的活动规律。

text: The education department stated that it will continue to expand the coverage of high-quality educational resources and promote balanced development this year.
src: 教育部门表示，今年将继续扩大优质教育资源覆盖面，推进均衡发展。

text: The National Bureau of Statistics released economic data for last month today.
src: 国家统计局今天发布了上月经济运行数据。

text: The meteorological department is advising the public to be on guard against severe convective weather.
src: 气象部门提醒市民注意防范强对流天气。

text: The newly opened intercity railway has cut the travel time between the two cities in half.
src: 新开通的城际铁路将两地车程缩短一半。

text: The expert team has begun a comprehensive assessment of the disaster-stricken areas.
src: 专家组对受灾地区展开全面评估工作。

text: This technology company has made a major breakthrough in overseas markets.
src: 这家科技公司在海外市场取得重大突破。

text: The winter heating work is now ready.
src: 冬季供暖工作目前已经准备就绪。

text: The municipal government announced the launch of a new round of renovation plans for old residential communities.
src: 市政府宣布启动新一轮老旧小区改造计划。

text: Research shows a positive correlation between urban green space and resident health.
src: 研究显示城市绿地面积与居民健康正相关。

text: Preparations for the National Games have entered the final sprint.
src: 全运会筹备工作进入最后冲刺阶段。

text: Relevant departments jointly conducted a major safety inspection.
src: 相关部门联合开展安全生产大检查。

text: The newly built museum will officially open to visitors next month.
src: 新建成的博物馆将于下月正式接待观众。

text: This year's grain output is expected to set another new record high.
src: 今年粮食产量有望再创历史新高。

text: Images of snow leopard activity were captured in the protected area for the first time.
src: 该片保护区首次拍到雪豹活动影像。

text: The organizers expect the number of visitors for this exhibition to exceed 100,000.
src: 主办方预计本届展会观众将超过十万人。

text: The medical team traveled deep into the mountains to provide free medical treatment to the villagers.
src: 医疗队深入山区为村民提供免费诊疗。

text: Travel time has been significantly shortened with the opening of the new route.
src: 新航线开通后旅客出行时间大为缩短。

text: Relevant authorities have requested that all localities make thorough preparations for flood control.
src: 有关部门要求各地切实做好防汛准备。

text: The completion of the bridge arch marks a key milestone in the project.
src: 大桥合龙标志着工程取得关键性进展。

text: The "Employment Service Week for College Graduates" event was launched today.
src: 高校毕业生就业服务周活动今天启动。

text: Most of the country will be sunny today.
src: 今天全国大部分地区晴朗。

text: The stock market closed slightly higher today.
src: 股市今日收盘小幅上涨。

text: The typhoon will make landfall in the coastal region tomorrow night.
src: 台风明晚登陆沿海地区。

text: The new subway line officially opens today.
src: 新地铁线路今天正式开通。

text: Citizens flock to the park to admire the flowers.
src: 市民纷纷前往公园赏花。

text: This exhibition will last for five days.
src: 本届展会为期五天。

text: The conference issued an important statement.
src: 会议发布了重要声明。

text: Airport flights returned to normal this morning.
src: 机场航班今晨恢复正常。

text: The new library will open to the public next week.
src: 新图书馆下周对外开放。

text: Heavy rain has caused some roads to flood.
src: 暴雨导致部分道路积水。

text: The champion team returns in triumph tonight.
src: 冠军队伍今晚凯旋归来。

text: The overall price level remains stable.
src: 物价水平保持总体稳定。

text: Giant panda cub makes its public debut.
src: 大熊猫幼崽首次公开亮相。

text: Highway tolls are now free starting today.
src: 高速公路今起限时免费。

text: The opening ceremony of the arts festival was packed to capacity.
src: 艺术节开幕式座无虚席。

text: Sales of new energy vehicles hit another record high.
src: 新能源汽车销量再创新高。

text: The research team successfully reached the target area.
src: 科考队顺利抵达目标区域。

text: Registration for the city marathon begins today.
src: 城市马拉松报名今日启动。

text: Yesterday I found a wallet on the subway and handed it to the station staff, hoping the owner can come and claim it soon.
src: 昨天在地铁上捡到一个钱包，交给了车站的工作人员，希望失主早点领回去。

text: If you had left half an hour earlier, you definitely wouldn't have gotten stuck in the evening rush hour traffic.
src: 你要是早半个小时出发，肯定就不会赶上晚高峰堵车了。

text: My parents are coming to stay for a while next month, and I plan to redecorate the second bedroom first.
src: 我爸妈下个月要来住一段时间，我打算先把次卧重新布置一下。

text: The rent is due this month, and the landlord said it's going up by 200 yuan each month for the next quarter.
src: 这个月房租到期了，房东说下个季度每个月要涨两百块钱。

text: At last week's class reunion, I almost didn't recognize several people. Time really flies.
src: 上周同学聚会，好几个人我差点都认不出来了，时间过得真快。

text: I couldn't sleep last night and tossed and turned until after 3 a.m. before I勉强 managed to fall asleep.
src: 我昨天晚上失眠，翻来覆去到凌晨三点多才勉强睡着。

text: The washing machine at home has been used for almost eight years and has been acting up recently, so I'm planning to get a new one.
src: 家里的洗衣机用了快八年了，最近老是出毛病，我打算换一台新的。

text: Send this video to the group chat so everyone can see it, it's pretty interesting.
src: 你把这段视频发到群里，让大家都看看，挺有意思的。

text: The tripe at this hot pot restaurant is especially fresh and worth a try.
src: 这家火锅店的毛肚特别新鲜，值得一试。

text: If you feel tired, just go back and rest early.
src: 你要是觉得累，就早点回去休息吧。

text: The shoes I bought last week are very comfortable to wear.
src: 我上周买的那双鞋穿着特别舒服。

text: Let's go for a walk in the suburbs this weekend to relax.
src: 咱们周末去郊外走走，放松一下心情。

text: He worked overtime until midnight yesterday, so he definitely won't be able to get up today.
src: 他昨天加班到半夜，今天肯定起不来。

text: Mom said the tomatoes grown at home are doing especially well this year.
src: 妈妈说家里种的西红柿今年长得特别好。

text: Please print two copies of this document and give them to the front desk.
src: 你把这份文件打印两份交给前台。

text: I've been learning to cook recently and things are going quite smoothly.
src: 我最近在学做菜，进展还挺顺利的。

text: The phone bill this month is a lot higher than last month's.
src: 这个月话费比上个月多了不少。

text: Guess who I ran into in the elevator today?
src: 你猜今天在电梯里遇到谁了？

text: The new bookstore downstairs from the company has a really nice environment.
src: 公司楼下新开的书店环境很不错。

text: I remember putting the keys in my bag.
src: 我记得把钥匙放在包里了呀。

text: Let's go to the movies this weekend.
src: 周末我们去看电影吧。

text: Have you had dinner yet?
src: 你吃晚饭了没有？

text: This outfit is on sale.
src: 这件衣服打折呢。

text: I'm going to the supermarket this afternoon.
src: 我下午去趟超市。

text: My phone battery is almost dead.
src: 我手机快没电了。

text: A new noodle shop opened downstairs.
src: 楼下新开了家面馆。

text: Have you recovered from your cold?
src: 你感冒好点了吗？

text: Are you free on Friday night?
src: 周五晚上有空吗？

text: The delivery has been left at the front desk.
src: 快递放在前台了。

text: I got a new haircut.
src: 我换了新发型。

text: This dish is a bit spicy.
src: 这道菜有点辣。

text: Where did you go over the weekend?
src: 你周末去哪玩了？

text: Unmanned driving systems need to fuse multi-source information from cameras, millimeter-wave radars, and ultrasonic sensors in real time.
src: 无人驾驶系统需要实时融合摄像头、毫米波雷达和超声波传感器的多源信息。

text: Voice enhancement algorithms aim to restore clean speech from noisy signals, with common methods including spectral subtraction and deep noise reduction.
src: 语音增强算法旨在从带噪信号中恢复干净语音，常见方法包括谱减和深度降噪。

text: Reverberation is formed by multiple reflections of sound waves in a room and significantly reduces the accuracy of far-field speech recognition.
src: 混响是声波在房间内多次反射形成的，会显著降低远场语音识别的准确率。

text: Neural machine translation has replaced traditional statistical methods, and its translation quality has approached human performance on many language pairs.
src: 神经机器翻译取代了传统的统计方法，翻译质量在许多语言对上已接近人类。

text: The emergent abilities of large models refer to the reasoning and generalization capabilities that suddenly appear after the parameter scale exceeds a certain threshold.
src: 大模型的涌现能力指参数规模超过某个阈值后突然出现的推理和泛化能力。

text: The chip design process includes front-end logic design, functional verification, physical layout, and tape-out verification.
src: 芯片设计流程包括前端逻辑设计、功能验证、物理布局和流片验证等环节。

text: Channel coding introduces redundant bits, enabling the receiver to detect and correct errors during transmission.
src: 信道编码通过引入冗余比特，使接收端能够检测并纠正传输中的错误。

text: The error rate of automatic speech recognition has fallen below five percent in quiet environments, but noisy scenarios still present challenges.
src: 自动语音识别的错误率在安静环境下已低于百分之五，但噪声场景仍充满挑战。

text: Convolutional neural networks are particularly well-suited for processing image data.
src: 卷积神经网络特别适合处理图像数据。

text: The emergence of large language models has transformed the paradigm of natural language processing.
src: 大语言模型的出现改变了自然语言处理范式。

text: Speech recognition systems typically consist of acoustic models and language models.
src: 语音识别系统通常包含声学模型和语言模型。

text: The transistor density of this processor has nearly doubled.
src: 这款处理器的晶体管密度提升了近一倍。

text: Quantum entanglement is one of the core resources in quantum computing.
src: 量子纠缠是量子计算的核心资源之一。

text: Blockchain technology is characterized by decentralization and immutability.
src: 区块链技术具有去中心化和不可篡改的特点。

text: Autonomous driving relies on multi-sensor fusion to perceive the environment.
src: 自动驾驶依赖多传感器融合感知环境。

text: Cloud computing platforms support scalable computing resources.
src: 云计算平台支持弹性伸缩的计算资源。

text: Recommendation systems rely on user behavior data for modeling.
src: 推荐系统依赖用户行为数据进行建模。

text: Semiconductor manufacturing requires extremely stringent cleanliness standards.
src: 半导体制造对洁净度要求极为苛刻。

text: Numerical weather forecasting depends on supercomputer computing power.
src: 数值天气预报依赖超级计算机算力。

text: Biometric technologies include fingerprint and facial recognition.
src: 生物识别技术包括指纹和人脸识别。

text: Neural networks require large amounts of data.
src: 神经网络需要大量数据。

text: This chip has very low power consumption.
src: 这款芯片功耗很低。

text: Algorithm complexity grows exponentially.
src: 算法复杂度呈指数增长。

text: LiDAR is used for ranging.
src: 激光雷达用于测距。

text: Bluetooth connection has been disconnected.
src: 蓝牙连接已断开。

text: Database query timed out.
src: 数据库查询超时。

text: Quantum computers are still in the experimental stage.
src: 量子计算机仍在实验阶段。

text: Battery life has increased by 20%.
src: 电池续航提升两成。

text: The camera supports night vision functionality.
src: 摄像头支持夜视功能。

text: The system vulnerability has been fixed.
src: 系统漏洞已被修复。

text: Wireless charging efficiency is relatively low.
src: 无线充电效率偏低。

text: The deep learning model has converged.
src: 深度学习模型已收敛。

text: The train departs from the South Station at 7:06 AM every morning, passes through six stations, and arrives at the destination at 10:40 AM.
src: 列车每天早上七点零六分从南站发车，途经六个站点，十点四十分抵达终点。

text: The anniversary celebration is scheduled for May 20th, when more than 3,000 alumni from home and abroad will return to campus.
src: 校庆活动安排在五月二十日，届时将有来自海内外的三千多名校友返校。

text: According to the meteorological department's forecast, the highest temperature during the day tomorrow will be 26 degrees, with the lowest at 14 degrees at night, accompanied by a north wind of level 3 to 4.
src: 据气象部门预报，明天白天最高气温二十六度，夜间最低十四度，伴有三到四级北风。

text: In the 20 years since its establishment, the company's business has expanded to cover more than 300 cities nationwide, serving over 80 million users.
src: 公司成立二十年来，业务已覆盖全国三百多个城市，服务用户超过八千万。

text: The charity gala raised a total of 26 million yuan, which will be fully used for educational projects in the western mountainous regions.
src: 这场慈善晚会共筹得善款两千六百万元，将全部用于西部山区的教育项目。

text: The new regulations will be implemented starting from January 1, 2025, with violators subject to a maximum fine of 500,000 yuan.
src: 新规自二零二五年一月一日起施行，违者最高可处五十万元罚款。

text: The flight from Tokyo to Paris will make a two-hour stopover in Frankfurt, with the entire journey expected to take 16 and a half hours.
src: 从东京飞往巴黎的航班将在法兰克福经停两小时，全程预计十六个半小时。

text: This bridge has a total length of 55 kilometers, a designed service life of 100 years, and can withstand earthquakes of magnitude 8.
src: 这座大桥全长五十五公里，设计使用寿命一百年，可抗八级地震。

text: The concert tickets are divided into three tiers, with the lowest being 280 yuan.
src: 这场演唱会的门票分为三档，最低两百八。

text: The meeting will be held at 9:00 AM on March 15th at the conference center.
src: 会议将于三月十五日上午九点在会议中心召开。

text: He lives at No. 88, Tiyu East Road, Tianhe District.
src: 他家住在天河区体育东路八十八号。

text: This project team has a total of 12 people, with an average age of 29.
